description:
Daily horoscope for a zodiac sign in 21 languages, written by a model from that sign's solar houses and the day's transits. `style: "plain"` gives everyday words with no astrological terms, written once in English and translated so every language says the same; `length` (short, medium) and `topics` choose its size and sections. Returns `sections` (overview, love, career, health, finance, advice) and the same text as `horoscope`, plus computed `transits` with solar houses, `aspects`, `events`, `energy` (1-10 with its factors), `lucky` and `compatibleSigns`.

[Group: Horoscope]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/horoscope/daily]
[Required: sign]
[Cost: 50 credits (Tier 3)]

length.description: With `style: "plain"`: `short` (about 70-110 words a day) or `medium` (default, about 150-230).

style.description: `astro` (default) names the planets, houses and aspects behind each point. `plain` uses everyday words with no astrological terms, and is written once in English and translated, so every language says the same thing. Daily, weekly and monthly.

topics.description: Only these sections, in this order, in `sections` and in `horoscope`. Default all six.

name: astroway_horoscope_daily
title: Daily Horoscope
